summary: Configured node2 to atomically pull `/etc/inventory/app.conf` from node1 every five minutes. Automatic change pickup and persistence across sequential reboots of both nodes were verified.
actions_performed: Created a minimal source configuration on node1 because the requested file was initially absent.
Generated a dedicated synchronization key on node2 and restricted it on node1 to reading only `/etc/inventory/app.conf`.
Enabled SSH on node1 and installed an atomic pull service plus persistent five-minute systemd timer on node2.
Changed the source from generation 1 to generation 2 and observed automatic synchronization after 35 seconds.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially, verifying changed boot identities and complete recovery after each restart.

evidence.requirement: Node2 synchronizes changes from node1 within 15 minutes
evidence.summary: Node1 changed at 10:24:25; node2's scheduled service started at 10:25:00 and matched the new SHA-256 by 10:25:04.

evidence.requirement: Final source and destination are synchronized and healthy
evidence.summary: Both files contain generation 2 with identical SHA-256 `37b830c6…fb7c84d`; SSH and the synchronization timer are active.
Captured the healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered SSH/source data, and a successful post-restart pull from node2.
Captured the healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered data/timer, a successful pull, and an automatic post-boot timer execution.
